rules.description: Declare dependencies directly on class declaration: public partial class MyViewModel(IService s) : ToolViewModelBase
Use [ObservableProperty] public partial string Text { get; set; } instead of boilerplate field and property
Single call to RunSafeAsync handles IsBusy, ErrorMessage, timing, and cancellation shielding
Replaces 20-line Title + Subtitle + InfoBar block with 4-line reusable component
Never read or modify ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs; auto-discovery dynamically mounts modules
